projects.release_date: <int> Earliest time period at which any job in this project may start.
projects.num_jobs: <int> Total number of jobs in this project, including artificial source and sink jobs.
projects.artificial_source_job_id: <int> Job identifier of the zero-duration dummy job marking the project start.
projects.artificial_sink_job_id: <int> Job identifier of the zero-duration dummy job marking the project end.

renewable.resource_id: <int> Unique identifier for this renewable resource.
renewable.capacity: <int> Maximum total consumption allowed across all jobs being processed simultaneously in any single time period.

nonrenewable.resource_id: <int> Unique identifier for this nonrenewable resource.
nonrenewable.capacity: <int> Maximum total consumption allowed across all jobs over the entire planning horizon.

jobs.project_id: <int> Identifier of the project this job belongs to.
jobs.type: <str> Role of the job: 'artificial_source' for the project start marker, 'artificial_sink' for the project end marker, or 'real' for an actual task.
jobs.successors: <list[int]> Job identifiers that must not start before this job finishes.

modes.mode_id: <int> Unique identifier for this execution mode within the job.
modes.duration: <int> Number of time periods required to complete the job when executed in this mode.
modes.renewable_consumption: <list[int], length num_renewable_resources> Amount of each renewable resource consumed per time period while the job is being processed in this mode.
modes.nonrenewable_consumption: <list[int], length num_nonrenewable_resources> Amount of each nonrenewable resource consumed over the entire execution of the job in this mode.
